d: Arsenal won 2-1, moving up to third place in the Champions League league phase table with 10 points. Noni Madueke opened the scoring just nine minutes in, sprinting down the right flank onto an instinctive flick from Viktor Gyökeres and slotting a low finish through the goalkeeper's legs. Making the most of a rotated starting lineup, Viktor Gyökeres turned from provider to goalscorer in the 38th minute, exchanging neat passes with Mikel Merino before burying a clinical shot off the far post.
